capabilities: Transcribe YouTube videos and audio or video files
Chat with vault notes using file, folder and tag mentions
Suggest folders, tags, titles and templates for notes
Record meetings and enhance them into structured notes
Run AI through cloud, self-hosted backend or local models
extras: Desktop-only; mobile Obsidian will not load it. Cloud use needs a paid subscription with a 7-day trial, while self-hosting is free. Provider API keys are configured on the backend, not in the plugin; the in-plugin local Ollama chat path is marked experimental and needs Catalyst access. A separate Note Companion mobile app is paused.
problem: Captured notes, links and recordings pile up in an inbox without folders, tags or titles, and Obsidian offers no built-in way to query vault content or turn media into structured notes.

relations.evidence: Multiple AI providers: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq, Ollama/local models, and custom base URLs
YouTube API: For fetching video transcripts when processing YouTube links

requires.name: AI provider API key (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Groq)

summary: AI assistant that transcribes audio and YouTube, chats with vault notes, and auto-organizes inbox files into folders, tags and templates.
